Data:Acted.connie.opera.apollo.sky.json.label: Acted: Connie
Data:Acted.connie.opera.apollo.sky.json.desc: MCO Lee was reassured that the opera might present a lesser oneiric hazard than she had feared... but resolved still to talk to 'our cousins of the Duties' in Paris.

Data:Acted.connie.project.ingenious.sky..label: Acted: Connie
Data:Acted.connie.project.ingenious.sky..desc: MCO Lee set off to track down the entity that she believed had murdered Zidane - a renegade spirit of the lower skies.

Data:Acted.connie.rising.moon.json.label: Acted: Connie
Data:Acted.connie.rising.moon.json.desc: MCO Lee, concerned at her superiors' request for her to research an oracle given by the Rising While, began to suspect that a 'Great Counterfeit' played some part in the affairs of the realm.

Data:Acted.connie.rite.renewal.moon.json.label: Acted: Connie
Data:Acted.connie.rite.renewal.moon.json.desc: MCO Lee researched 'countermeasures' at Hush House, hoping to limit any damage caused by the rite

Data:Acted.coquille.box.knock.json.label: Acted: Coquille
Data:Acted.coquille.box.knock.json.desc: Princess Coquille believed she'd learnt from her research at Hush House how to breach the Coffin.

Data:Acted.coquille.heist.knock.json.label: Acted: Coquille
Data:Acted.coquille.heist.knock.json.desc: Princess Coquille, investigating ways by which the Oriflamme Heist might have been managed, happened across 'something rather smashing.'

Data:Acted.coquille.intrusion.knock.json.label: Acted: Coquille
Data:Acted.coquille.intrusion.knock.json.desc: Princess Coquille suspected that the irruption of Worms in Kraków might be connected, somehow, with the sword Ebrehel.

Data:Acted.coquille.opera.apollo.grail.j.label: Acted: Coquille
Data:Acted.coquille.opera.apollo.grail.j.desc: Princess Coquille was confident she would be the best-dressed woman in the audience.

Data:Acted.coquille.opera.wings.grail.js.label: Acted: Coquille
Data:Acted.coquille.opera.wings.grail.js.desc: Princess Coquille hoped to find her family at the opera - that is, her newest family.

Data:Acted.coquille.revolution.grail.jso.label: Acted: Coquille
Data:Acted.coquille.revolution.grail.jso.desc: Princess Coquille found a very special gift for her very special officer friend in the Legion.

Data:Acted.corso.mystical.lantern.json.label: Acted: Corso
Data:Acted.corso.mystical.lantern.json.desc: Corso suggested that the new doctrines had suggested a connection to him - between the enigmatic Hour called the Chandler, and a Name of the Watchman: Sunset Celia.

Data:Acted.corso.omen.dawn.lantern.json.label: Acted: Corso
Data:Acted.corso.omen.dawn.lantern.json.desc: Corso determined that the manuscript the Church had given him to authenticate - with its details of the prophecy of the Unfettered Eye - was a forgery.

Data:Acted.corso.opera.apollo.grail.json.label: Acted: Corso
Data:Acted.corso.opera.apollo.grail.json.desc: Corso improved his knowledge of 'stains'... hopefully, enough to identify the 'savour-arts' book he hoped to acquire in Paris.

Data:Acted.corso.opera.wings.grail.json.label: Acted: Corso
Data:Acted.corso.opera.wings.grail.json.desc: Corso found a bribe that he thought might persuade someone to 'sit at the back' of the performance, and help him authenticate a book that might be a copy of the libretto.

Data:Acted.corso.project.solar.lantern.j.label: Acted: Corso
Data:Acted.corso.project.solar.lantern.j.desc: Corso went glumly back to his 'foreign friends', to warn them that their concerns about the nature of the Royal Endeavour might be justified.

Data:Acted.corso.revolution.grail.json.label: Acted: Corso
Data:Acted.corso.revolution.grail.json.desc: Corso sought an unknown Hattington work in the Bounds - and hoped that he'd identified a suitable bribe for the 'lady' who held it.

Data:Acted.dagmar.box.knock.json.label: Acted: Dagmar
Data:Acted.dagmar.box.knock.json.desc: 'Daymare' left Hush House with a plan to ensure 'St Mihail', whatever he might actually be, stayed in his coffin.

Data:Acted.dagmar.heist.knock.json.label: Acted: Dagmar
Data:Acted.dagmar.heist.knock.json.desc: 'Daymare' was clearly concerned that she might be blamed for the heist, real or not, justly or not - but her researches at Hush House gave her hope that she might escape suspicion.

Data:Acted.dagmar.intrusion.knock.json.label: Acted: Dagmar
Data:Acted.dagmar.intrusion.knock.json.desc: 'Daymare', unimpressed by the Bureau's claims of expertise, set off to Kraków to make sure that the seals restraining the Worms were up to her standards.

Data:Acted.dagmar.lost.find.rose.json.label: Acted: Dagmar
Data:Acted.dagmar.lost.find.rose.json.desc: Something in the story of the Dappled Rose made 'Daymare' wonder if she should return to Miah, one more time...

Data:Acted.dagmar.omen.horizon.rose.json.label: Acted: Dagmar
Data:Acted.dagmar.omen.horizon.rose.json.desc: 'Daymare' definitely decided not to seek Ys. Definitely. Under no circumstances.

Data:Acted.dagmar.stalk.rose.json.label: Acted: Dagmar
Data:Acted.dagmar.stalk.rose.json.desc: 'Daymare' went off to Budapest to look into the Medusa business, insisting that she wasn't doing so as any kind of favour for any kind of friend, especially not one whose name might begin with K.

Data:Acted.douglas.curse.heart.json.label: Acted: Douglas Moore
Data:Acted.douglas.curse.heart.json.desc: DI Moore set off to resolve the Grunewald problem, buoyed by what he'd learnt at Hush House.

Data:Acted.douglas.mystical.lantern.json.label: Acted: Douglas Moore
Data:Acted.douglas.mystical.lantern.json.desc: DI Moore was mostly concerned that the cults might be a breeding ground for Long - and so increase the incidence of the Crime of the Sky.

Data:Acted.douglas.omen.dawn.lantern.jso.label: Acted: Douglas Moore
Data:Acted.douglas.omen.dawn.lantern.jso.desc: DI Moore remained uncertain about events in Messana, but promised to mention to the Bureau that I'd been of assistance.

Data:Acted.douglas.pan.heart.json.label: Acted: Douglas Moore
Data:Acted.douglas.pan.heart.json.desc: DI Moore decided that there was nothing at the Lyterion that merited Bureau investigation.

Data:Acted.douglas.project.solar.lantern.label: Acted: Douglas Moore
Data:Acted.douglas.project.solar.lantern.desc: DI Moore came to investigate likely motives for sabotage of the Royal Endeavour by maverick clergy... and left with a 'much better idea about who might need arresting.'

Data:Acted.douglas.wound.heart.json.label: Acted: Douglas Moore
Data:Acted.douglas.wound.heart.json.desc: DI Moore concluded that the 'Open Reverend' would have to be permanently closed.

Data:Acted.ehsan.curse.heart.json.label: Acted: Ehsan
Data:Acted.ehsan.curse.heart.json.desc: Ehsan, requested by the Bureau to help them resolve the Grunewald matter, came to Hush House seeking ways to protect himself during the process.

Data:Acted.ehsan.observe.scaly.sky.json.label: Acted: Ehsan
Data:Acted.ehsan.observe.scaly.sky.json.desc: Ehsan set out to help patients who had heard the call of the clouds -  by suppressing their mania to travel West - though not without some qualms.

Data:Acted.ehsan.opera.apollo.sky.json.label: Acted: Ehsan
Data:Acted.ehsan.opera.apollo.sky.json.desc: What Ehsan learnt at Hush House convinced him that the production would not trouble the lower skies - especially, perhaps, with his intercession.

Data:Acted.ehsan.pan.heart.json.label: Acted: Ehsan
Data:Acted.ehsan.pan.heart.json.desc: Ehsan noted a resemblance between the operations of the Lyterion, and the work of Thirza Blake, seventh Librarian of the House.

Data:Acted.ehsan.project.ingenious.sky.j.label: Acted: Ehsan
Data:Acted.ehsan.project.ingenious.sky.j.desc: Ehsan had hoped that Zidane's memorial composition might be played on the Unfinished Lark itself - but after researching the matter at Hush House, he came to believe that might be too dangerous.

Data:Acted.ehsan.wound.heart.json.label: Acted: Ehsan
Data:Acted.ehsan.wound.heart.json.desc: Ehsan became convinced that the Open Reverend had attracted the attention of the Mother of Ants - but determined, nevertheless, that he would try to heal the poor fellow.

Data:Acted.franklin.numa.grail.a.grail.j.label: Acted: Bancroft
Data:Acted.franklin.numa.grail.a.grail.j.desc: '...count on a poet to…charlatan. Our daughter...'

Data:Acted.franklin.numa.grail.b.grail.j.label: Acted: Bancroft
Data:Acted.franklin.numa.grail.b.grail.j.desc: '...once we've begun, there's no end to it. Without the Grail, no Intercalate; without the Intercalate, how would the Hours keep from...'

Data:Acted.franklin.numa.wood.grail.json.label: Acted: Bancroft
Data:Acted.franklin.numa.wood.grail.json.desc: '...optimism? If you term it that! I do not deny the Hours. But who else than we would make these Histories, in the face of all the Glory's lights, if...'

Data:Acted.fraser.hunt.changing.scale.js.label: Acted: Strathcoyne
Data:Acted.fraser.hunt.changing.scale.js.desc: Fraser Strathcoyne hoped, but not did expect, to shield Abecassis from his hunters.

Data:Acted.fraser.mystical.lantern.json.label: Acted: Strathcoyne
Data:Acted.fraser.mystical.lantern.json.desc: Fraser Strathcoyne believed that something had drawn the Obliviates - the Long who'd secluded themselves in Port Noon - back to the world.

Data:Acted.fraser.observe.scaly.scale.js.label: Acted: Strathcoyne
Data:Acted.fraser.observe.scaly.scale.js.desc: Fraser Strathcoyne was eager to travel West and embrace his latent second nature.
